data.split: preference data from 1000 KTVIC train images (never dev300); gate on dev300; no test look

data/datasets/ktvic/train_data.json.note: dev300 is a subset of KTVIC train; its 5 references per image are the dev gold

rl_images.rule: train_rl.schedule(ids of data/splits/ktvic_train_minus_dev300.txt, 1000, 42); the same images as the RL gate v2 first look

data.gold_ktvic5_train: union of objects_in classes over each train image's 5 references (pair labels and RFT targets; human labels, candidates flagged MODEL-GENERATED)
data.anchor: the image's first human reference (P1's own SFT target)

panel.use: dev evaluation only; never in pairs, targets, selection or stopping

procedure.step0: Step 0, before any training or scoring: re-decode p1dev_s42 on dev300 on this job's machine (evaluate.py, short prompt, bf16, its defaults) under the name p1dev_s42_redecode. Every paired comparison uses this same-machine decode. Its agreement with the registered n2 decode (share of identical captions, CIDEr-D difference) is reported, never used to select anything.
procedure.pool: e5_sample.py --adapter runs/p1dev_s42 --split train_data.json --images-file <RL ids> --limit 0 --prompt short --n 6 --temperature T --top-p 0.95 --seed 42, for T = 0.5 and 0.8; per image the 6+6 samples are merged in that order
procedure.train_greedy: greedy short-prompt decode of P1_dev on the RL images (evaluate.py's prompt and decoding settings): the CM-RFT count and the copy-guard baseline
procedure.pairs: the M3 builder rules (draft .session_backup/2026-10-14/research_r10/M3/cm_pairs.py, to be committed as scripts/cm_pairs.py): candidates are the pool samples (greedy excluded), deduplicated, minus those empty, with CJK, ending in a function word, or copying a reference (rl_reward.copy_stat m >= 0.9); a pair (w, l) of one image needs |M(w)| = |M(l)| = k >= 1, |syllables(w) - syllables(l)| <= 2 and TP(w) >= TP(l) + 1 against ktvic5 train gold; at most 4 pairs per image, largest dTP first, then seeded random (seed 42)
procedure.dpo: train_stage2.py --stage dpo --data <pairs> --adapter runs/p1dev_s42 --out runs/cmdpo_A_s42 --epochs 1 --beta 0.1 --lr 5e-6 --grad-accum 8 --anchor-sft 1.0 --seed 42; reference = the start adapter (ref_sft); the anchor adds 1.0 x the response-only CE on the image's first human caption; no NLL on the chosen caption; first a 20-pair dry run (gradient check, peak reserved <= 22 GB, pair-ordering accuracy logged)
procedure.rft: targets: per RL image, among the usable pool samples (same filters as the pairs) whose class count equals that of P1_dev's greedy caption, the one with the most ktvic5 train-gold classes, kept only if its TP exceeds the greedy's; ties by CIDEr-D against references 1-4 (leaving out reference 0, the SFT target; rl_reward.CiderD, train-minus-dev300 document frequencies), then the lower pool index. Rows: for each kept image one row with the target and one with the image's first human caption (1:1). train_stage2.py --stage sft --data <rft> --adapter runs/p1dev_s42 --out runs/cmrft_s42 --epochs 1 --lr 1e-5 --loss-mask assistant --seed 42
procedure.fallback_A-KL: runs only if arm A's verdict is KILL and guard G2 or G3 failed (R14-2: 'runs ONLY after a guard kill on G2/G3'): the anchor is replaced by a token-wise forward KL to pi_SFT on the chosen response (alpha 0.4), lr 2.5e-6, same pairs and settings otherwise; its verdict replaces arm A's
procedure.decode: evaluate.py short greedy on dev300 for each arm; greedy on the first 250 RL images for each arm (copy guard)
procedure.checkpoint: the last checkpoint only (gate v2 lesson); no best-of-checkpoints; checkpoints every 200 steps exist for resuming only

analysis.classes: objects_in (matcher v2), exact classes; m = mean distinct classes per caption
analysis.d_res: residual(x) = F1_ktvic5(x) - prereg_ladder_check.at(frontier, m(x))[2], with object_prf.scores F1 (P = sum TP / sum M; R = mean per-image recall) and the frozen frontier anchors of the ladder prereg; d_res = residual(arm) - residual(P1_dev same-machine decode)
analysis.panel_cm: panel-side count-matched F1: on the 296 panel images with k_arm(i) = k_P1dev(i) (same number of distinct classes), object_prf.scores F1 against the panel classes, arm minus P1_dev; the matched share is reported (few matched images widen the CI, which the gate penalises)

ci.method: paired percentile bootstrap: dev images for d_res, the matched panel images for panel_cm

frozen_predictions.scale: CHAIR_i on the 0-1 scale of the result JSONs; CIDEr-D x100

guards.G1: |dm| <= 0.2 (dm = mean classes per caption, arm minus P1_dev)
guards.G3: at most 1 of 300 dev captions contain CJK (scripts/cjk_rate.score_mapping)
guards.G5: at most 15 of 300 fragment captions (rl_report.fragments: END from train-minus-dev300 references)
guards.G6: copy guard (PD-9 Q2; gate v2's G4): exact-copy rate of the arm's greedy captions on the first 250 RL images <= 2 x max(P1_dev's rate on the same images, 1/250); an exact copy has rl_reward.copy_stat edit distance 0 to one of the image's 5 references (content words)

gate.verdict_CM-DPO: PASS iff all guards hold, d_res >= +1.5, d_res_lo > 0 and panel_cm_lo > −0.5; GREY iff all guards hold, panel_cm_lo > −0.5, not PASS, and either +0.5 <= d_res < +1.5 or (d_res >= +1.5 and d_res_lo <= 0); KILL otherwise
gate.verdict_CM-RFT: PASS iff all guards hold, d_res >= +1.0, d_res_lo > 0 and panel_cm_lo > −0.5; GREY iff all guards hold, panel_cm_lo > −0.5, not PASS and d_res >= +0.3; KILL otherwise
gate.S3_passes: an arm PASSES; GREY carries no claim and enables nothing without a new judge decision
gate.H5_claim: the 'both P and R rise' reading holds iff dP > 0 and dR > 0 (point); it is withdrawn if dR < 0 with its 95% CI upper bound < 0 (R14-2 writes 'dR < 0 with LB > 0', read here as a recall loss whose CI excludes 0); it does not change the gate

consequences.S4: needs S2 G0 PASS and an arm-A (or A-KL) PASS (R14 synthesis Stage 2)
consequences.S7: not opened by this job; it may be proposed only after S3 or S4 passes, as a new judge request with a fresh prereg (PD-9 Q3)
consequences.M3_stages_2_3: the C1/C2 controls, the COCO arm and any test look need their own preregs
consequences.KILL: reported as a pre-registered negative with CIs

disclosures: The M3 CPU pilot on the dev pools (pair supply, in-sample and split-annotator ceilings) and R14-3's oracle headroom were seen before this registration; they set the design, not any threshold here.
The anchor is one extra epoch of SFT on the RL images' first references, which P1_dev was trained on; G6 guards the copying this can cause.
The panel-side estimator conditions on images whose class count did not change, a post-treatment subset; its matched share is reported.
Union gold rewards naming habits as well as truth (R14-2 §7); the panel is the truth-side check.
deviations: Any change after this freeze goes into a new dated file, committed through the gatekeeper before the affected output exists, and is reported as a deviation next to every number it touches.

Literature support: HALVA (Cover +2.0, CHAIR -1.2) is the closest published effect of count-preserving pairs. The in-house ceiling at fixed count is +6.64 [+4.72, +8.66] in-sample and +4.64 split-annotator; vote share only +0.24. - Expected (dev300 vs P1_dev): d-res +0.5 to +2.0 F1; dCHAIR_i -0.005 to -0.020; |dm| <= 0.10; dCIDEr in [-3, +2]. - Gate note (for the judge): the AUROC >= 0.58 gate tests EV-RANK's probe, not M3's signal. M3's split-annotator +4.64 is direct held-out evidence. Recommend replacing the gate with M3's own stage-1 gate. Judge decision required; not decided here. - 35_e risk and avoidance: no CIDEr reward, so there is no gradient toward copying references; the copy mask drops pairs at m >= 0.90; add guard G6 copy rate <= 2x P1_dev (R10 item 3); the anchor is on the first human caption, not on model text. ### P-2 (rank 2): CM-RFT, count-matched rejection-sampling SFT (expert iteration) on M3's pool - What: for each of the 1,000 images, take from the 12-sample pool the sample with the SAME k as P1_dev's greedy that has the most union-gold classes (ties broken by LOO CIDEr-D). At 3 seeds
